summary: ATV driver rolled the machine off the Rainbow Trail between the Macey Lake trailhead and the North Colony Lakes trailhead; three ATV teams and one ground team responded from the Horn Creek trailhead; the subject was brought back to the Horn Creek trailhead and transported by Flight For Life Lifeguard 4 at 2130.
location: Rainbow Trail between Macey Lake TH and N. Colony Lakes TH
notes: Source: Custer County SAR Facebook page.
